content.text: {"name":"长安暮色琉璃灯","palette":["#120d1a","#1f1830","#2e2440","#4a2f3a","#7a3b2e","#a8502f","#3f5a5e","#e0a54a","#ffd98a"],"background":"Dusk sky painted as a vertical linear gradient from deep indigo #1f1830 at the top through plum #2e2440 to a warm ember band of #7a3b2e near the horizon (at about 50% height), then dropping back to near-black #120d1a at the bottom edge; one or two broad horizontal haze bands of #4a2f3a at 25-35% opacity across the far city; a radial vignette of #120d1a at 45% opacity darkens all four corners.","line":"Mostly lineless flat shapes; where edges are needed (roof eaves, bracket sets, balustrades, window lattices) use 2-3px strokes in #120d1a at 60% opacity with round caps and joins; highlight edges are 2px strokes in #e0a54a at 70% opacity on the lit side only; far layers have no strokes at all.","shapes":"Geometric-architectural shapes softened by 4-8px corner radii: sweeping upturned Ming-dynasty hip-and-gable roofs with curved eaves, stacked dougong brackets simplified to rhythmic blocks, square brick terraces with arched gate tunnels; each main form is split into a lit plane (#a8502f / #e0a54a) and a shadow plane (#2e2440 / #3f5a5e for glazed green tiles), shading done with 2-3 flat tonal steps plus gentle linear gradients, never airbrushed realism.","composition":"The Bell Tower or main subject sits centred or slightly off-centre within the upper 55% of the 1920x1080 frame, its roof peak around y=180-260; horizon and street vanishing points at roughly y=540-590; the lower 45% (y>594) is a calm, dim zone of dark plaza paving, wide avenues fading into shadow, or the city-wall walkway in #1f1830 to #120d1a with only faint low-contrast lantern reflections (max 20% opacity), no bright details, no small busy elements, so white Chinese text and subtitles read clearly.","mood":"A warm, hushed Xi'an twilight where amber lantern glow kindles on the ancient tower against a deep violet sky, nostalgic and dignified.","motifs":"Red silk lanterns with golden glow halos, upturned eaves with glazed green-teal tiles, golden lit windows in lattice patterns, the four radiating avenues (east, west, south, north) with streams of soft warm light points, distant city-wall battlements as silhouettes, drifting ember-like dust motes and a few early stars, a pale crescent moon in the upper left sky.","lighting":"One key light for the whole video: low warm sunset from the lower right (behind the viewer's right, about 20 degrees above horizon) in #e0a54a, so right-facing planes are lit and left-facing planes fall into shadow #2e2440; artificial lantern and window light in #ffd98a with radial glows (radius 40-120px, opacity 35-55%, fading to transparent); a thin rim light of #ffd98a at 60% along the right edges of roofs and pillars; cast shadows in #120d1a at 40-50% opacity, soft with 12-20px blur, falling toward the lower left.","depth":"Five layers back to front: (1) sky gradient with stars and moon; (2) far city skyline and wall silhouettes in #3f5a5e blended 65% into the haze colour #4a2f3a; (3) mid-ground street buildings and trees in #2e2440 at 35% haze, with sparse warm windows; (4) the subject (Bell Tower, its terrace, or the view from its balcony) at full contrast and most detail; (5) dark foreground framing such as a silhouetted eave corner, wooden balustrade, or hanging lantern in #120d1a at the frame edges, plus the dim plaza or walkway filling the lower area.","texture":"Overall film grain at opacity 0.08; subtle low-contrast patterns at 6-10% opacity: running-bond brick on the terrace and city wall, curved tile rows on roofs, fine wood grain on pillars and balustrades, square lattice on windows, faint stone-slab grid on the plaza; small particles (warm dust and ember motes in #ffd98a at 20-40% opacity, 2-4px) only in the upper and middle bands."}
